name: monolith-platform
description: Monolith Hub - Central Hub & App Launcher for Lifestyle, Work, and Gaming with SSO

scripts.predev: npm run generate && npm run build:packages
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n hub,arena "npm run dev --workspace=@monolith/hub" "npm run dev --workspace=@monolith/demo-sub-app"
scripts.predev:hub: npm run generate && npm run build:packages
scripts.prebuild: npm run generate && npm run build:packages
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@monolith/hub && npm run build --workspace=@monolith/demo-sub-app
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.cf:build: npm run cf:build:hub && npm run cf:build:demo
scripts.cf:build:hub: npm run generate && npm run build:packages && npm run build:worker --workspace=@monolith/hub
scripts.cf:build:demo: npm run build:packages && npm run build:worker --workspace=@monolith/demo-sub-app
scripts.cf:check: npm run check:worker --workspace=@monolith/hub && npm run check:worker --workspace=@monolith/demo-sub-app
